newsitem.title: GERMANY: Buba-August 6-mo bank lending up annualised 7 pct.
newsitem.headline: Buba-August 6-mo bank lending up annualised 7 pct.

text.p: The Bundesbank on Thursday said that six month bank lending grew at an annualised rate of seven percent.
The Bundesbank also said that expanded M3 money supply, which includes money market funds, grew at an annualised rate of 6.5 percent in the six months to July.

The Bundesbank also said money supply growth in the six months through August grew at an annualised 6.8 percent rate compared with the six month annualised rate through July which grew at an 8.6 percent rate.
